answers.core:
It is not something an addon can provide because it needs to be exposed on `Tree` and to the Scripting API.

---

PR for this is implemented: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/113378
answers.workaround: The only solution right now is to make the assumption that `Popup` is always the first child below `Tree`, but this is scene sniff behavior that can easily break across releases and does not provide any stable and reliable way to access the underlying `Popup`. Furthermore, other UI widgets expose the underlying `Popup` for various other reasons, so this change aligns with existing standards.

title: Expose the `Popup` instance used by the `Tree` component
